full_judgment:
2. Prosecution case, in brief, was that one Mst. Lucky Begum along with other near relatives on 30-5-2006 at about 22-30 hours in the night appeared before the Kotalipara Police Station and lodged an ejahar contending, inter-alia, that on 20-12-2005 due to earlier relationship her Bhasur's son Hanif Beg and her Chachato Bhasur Siraj Beg's daughter Rina Khanom left the house without knowledge of others. On 22-12-2005, they got married in Dhaka by registered kabinnama, the informant and others got information through mobile phone. Siraj Beg, father of Rina Khanom, filed a case before the Nari-o-Shishu Nirjatan Daman Tribunal, Gopalgonj against five accused persons. Thereafter, three (3) cases were filed against them which are pending before the Courts below. In the meantime, near relatives of both the sides tried to settle the matter through village salish on several occasions, but in vain. On 29-5-2006 at about 7-00 am some elite persons of the locality ensured them that they will settle the dispute. Contrariwise, at about 8-00 am the petitioner-Kamrul and Abdul Mannan with their own men came to their house and declared that they would break everything and nothing would be remained in their house. On the same day, at about 12-30 hours, the informant's sister-in-law (Ja) Razia Begum went for family work to the neighbouring house of Ramproshad; her Bhasur's son Omar, at about quarter to 1-00 pm, also went to the house of Ramproshad. While he was returning at about 1-30 hours and reached near the coconut tree of the southern side of Hari Chand and Ramproshad's house, he saw that the accused persons namely Swapon Beg, Layek Mir, Kalam Kazi, Zahuri Mia, Abdul Mannan Sheikh, Ziaul Khan, Siraj Beg, Tuhin Bhuiyan, Tahid Bhuiyan, Jhontu Mollah, Azad Kazi, Shah Alam Bhuiyan, Tazim Miah, Zahangir Mollah, Md Shakhawat Hossain Bhuiyan alias Thanda, Sawkat, Abdul Mollah, Shahidul Bhuiyan, Sohel Khan, Bellal Sheikh, Mintu Mollah, Shah Alam Sheikh, Monir Sheikh, Zakir Sheikh along with other 100 unknown persons being armed with dao, lathi, katra, sorki, Hocky stick etc. in their hands closed the road. On hearing the hue and cry raised by Omar, the informant, her husband Kalam Beg, Debor Jamal Beg, Bhasur's son Hanif Beg, Chachato Bhasur Yeakub Ali Beg, Chand Mia Kazi and Alauddin Kazi came to the place of occurrence, then the accused Swapon Beg dealt a blow with the ramdao aiming at the head of her husband Kalam Beg who tried to resist by the right hand, thereby, caused serious grievous injury in the right hand, at that time Layek Mir dealt a blow with Katra to his left side of the head in order to kill him, Kalam Kazi dealt a blow with the Dao to his left leg thigh which caused grievous injury, then her husband fell down on the ground. Accused Mannan Sheikh dealt 3 blows with Hockey stick on the chest of her husband, the accused Zahur dealt 2 blows with Hockey stick on the right side in the waist of her husband; the accused Zahur dealt horrendous pressure in the leg and chest of her husband, at that time Alauddin Kazi, Yeakub Beg and Chand Mia Kazi went to rescue her husband, then the accused Belal dealt a blow with Hockey stick in the right leg of Alauddin Kazi causing bone breaking injury; the accused Sohel dealt a blow with the Sorki in the right thigh of Alauddin causing serious bleeding injury; the accused Mintu dealt hit with Hockey stick on the forehead of Yeakub Beg causing bleeding injury. At that time, her Debor Jalal Beg and Bhasur's son came forward to rescue her husband, then the accused Md Shakawat Hossain Bhuiyan alias Thanda dealt 3/4 blows with the Bamboo lathi on the left hand causing deadly injuries, the accused Shawkat Bhuiyan dealt a blow with Sorki on the left side of the chest of Hanif causing cutting injury, while injured Hanif, Jalal Beg, Alauddin Kazi and Yeakub Beg were running towards their house, the accused Siraj Beg, Tuhin Bhuiyan, Tahid Bhuiyan, Jhontu Mollah, Azad Kazi, Shah Alam Bhuiyan, Tazim Jahangir Mollah, Abul Mollah, Faridul Bhuiyan, Shaba Alam Sheikh, Munir Sheikh and Zakir Sheikh with others chased them and entered into their house. On the direction of Zakir Sheikh, accused Siraj Beg and Tahid Bhuiyan entered into her Bhasur's house and took away one trunk in which one gold chain valued at Taka 8,000, two gold churies valued at Taka 5,000, clothes valued at Taka 1,500. Other accused persons opened the tin of the house causing damage of Taka 10,000. At that time the local people and police appeared therein then accused persons ran away. After the occurrence, the informant, her sister-in-law (Ja), Ruma, Sukuron of the neighbouring house brought her husband inside the house in serious condition. Subsequently they took him to Kotalipara hospital by van for treatment; the Doctor found the condition of victim is serious, therefore, referred him to the Gopalgonj Sadar Hospital; the informant; Ziaur, Sikder, Nazrul Sarder took him and admitted him in Gopalgonj Sadar hospital on 30-5-2006 at about 6-15 hours in the morning, her husband Kalam Beg died during treatment. Accordingly, First Information Report (in shortly, FIR) was lodged before the Officer-in-Charge of Kotalipara Police Station, Gopalgonj under sections 143/447/448/307/341/323/324/427/325/ 302/380/114/109/34 of the Penal Code, 1860 (in shortly the Code) against the accused persons. Accordingly, Kotalipara PS Case No. 7 dated 30-5-2006 corresponding to GR Case No.30/2006 (Kotali) was started against the accused persons. 

 3. The police, after completion of investigation, submitted Charge-sheet No.31 dated 30-7-2006 under sections 143/447/448/431/323/325/ 307/302/380/427/109/114/34 of the Code against accused persons.
